statusLine.command: input=$(cat); t=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".transcript_path // \"\""); tok=0; [ -f "$t" ] && tok=$(jq -s "[.[]|select(.isSidechain!=true)|.message.usage|select(.!=null)|(.input_tokens//0)+(.cache_creation_input_tokens//0)+(.cache_read_input_tokens//0)]|last//0" "$t"); win=200000; case "$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".model.id // \"\"")" in *"[1m]"*) win=1000000;; esac; printf "%s%% context" "$((tok*100/win))"
